'''Tremor Base''', also known as '''Imperial Outpost RD778083''', was an [[Imperial Outpost]] established on [[Otavon XII]] during the early years of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. It was used as an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] production facility.

During its existence, it was continually harassed by [[Ovoni]] rebels, who later succeeded in [[Battle of Otavon XII|destroying]] it thanks to the sacrifice of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Hylon]]. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Crik]] of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] was the commanding officer of the base and defended it with a force of [[clone stormtrooper]]s and [[Clone scout trooper/Legends|clone scout troopers]], all of whom would be destroyed alongside Tremor Base itself.<ref name="P:THB" />
